meta.homeTitle: Rugby Timer · Match clock for rugby referees

cta.download: Get it on the App Store

hero.title: The match clock that keeps up with the game
hero.subtitle: Run the clock, sin-bins and score from your Apple Watch or iPhone, and keep your eyes on the game.

features.title: Less time on the device, more on the game
features.intro: Rugby Timer was built by a referee, for referees. Every screen is designed for sunlight, floodlights, wet gloves and a quick glance.

items.title: A clock you can read
items.body: Big, high-contrast numbers for each half, from 40 minutes down to 7 for sevens, with time played past the clock recorded.

items.title: Cards and sin-bins
items.body: A yellow card starts a 10-minute countdown on its own. See who's off and for how long, at a glance.

items.title: Score in two taps
items.body: Tries, conversions, penalties, drop goals and penalty tries, with the scorer's shirt number.

items.title: Lock Screen and widgets
items.body: A Live Activity keeps the clock and score on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Widgets show the last result.

items.title: Apple Watch first
items.body: Set up on iPhone, run the match from your wrist, with alerts at half-time and when a sin-bin ends.

items.title: Match record
items.body: Every score and card with its minute, ready to share as text with the teams or your referees' society.

items.title: The match on your Lock Screen
items.body: Lock your iPhone and the clock keeps counting where you can see it, with the score and any player in the sin-bin.
points: Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your last result
Turn it off any time in Settings

items.title: Every score, every sin-bin
items.body: A running timeline of the match, with each yellow card counting down until the player can return.
points: Scoring timeline with the minute and the running score
Sin-bin countdowns that run with the clock
Penalty and free-kick counts for each team

items.title: Fast, even with wet gloves
items.body: Pick the team and shirt number, then the score or the card. Large targets and no fiddly menus.
points: Undo the last score or card for 15 seconds
A second yellow for the same player prompts a red

items.title: A match record in seconds
items.body: At full time, Rugby Timer writes the match record for you: final score, a minute-by-minute timeline and the discipline summary.
points: Share it as text with any app
Every finished match kept in your history on iPhone
Read and share a past match again any time

watch.title: The whole match on your wrist
watch.body: Send the setup from your iPhone, or start a Quick Match on the Watch alone. The clock, the score and the sin-bins stay on your wrist.

points.title: Alerts, wrist down
points.body: Haptic alerts at half-time, at the end of the break and when a sin-bin ends.

points.title: Rugby workout
points.body: Optionally record each match as a workout in Health, with distance, heart rate and energy.

points.title: Tap lock
points.body: A sleeve or a wet glove won't change the match by accident.

points.title: Quick Match
points.body: No phone at the ground? Set up and run a match on the Watch alone.

more.title: Ready for any fixture
more.intro: From club sevens to knockout finals, Rugby Timer adapts to the match in front of you.

items.title: iPhone-only mode
items.body: No Apple Watch? Run the whole match on your iPhone.

items.title: Crash recovery
items.body: If the app closes mid-match, it reopens right where you were, clock and sin-bins included.

items.title: Extra time
items.body: Two 10-minute halves then sudden death, or 5-minute sudden-death periods for sevens.

items.title: Injury timers
items.body: HIA (12 minutes) and blood replacement (15 minutes) timers, logged in the match record.

items.title: Coin toss
items.body: An optional coin toss on the Watch to decide who kicks off.

items.title: Four languages
items.body: English, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese, on iPhone and Apple Watch.

privacy.title: Your matches stay with you
privacy.body: Rugby Timer doesn't send your data to any server, including ours. Workouts go only to the Health app on your devices.

items.q: Do I need an Apple Watch?
items.a: No. You can run the whole match on your iPhone. With an Apple Watch, you set up on the iPhone and run the match from your wrist, or start a Quick Match on the Watch alone.
Rugby Timer is a one-time purchase of US$1.99 in the United States; the App Store shows the price in your country. There are no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

items.q: Does it need an internet connection?
items.a: No. The app works offline. Your iPhone and Apple Watch talk to each other directly over Bluetooth or local Wi-Fi.

items.q: Can I match my competition's rules?
items.a: Yes. Set the half length, sin-bin length, half-time break, extra time and the 20-minute red card to match your competition, and save your defaults.
English, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese. The language follows your device, and you can change it in Settings.

items.q: What do I need to run it?
items.a: An iPhone with iOS 26.5 or later. An Apple Watch with watchOS 26.5 or later is optional.

final.title: Ready for kick-off?
final.body: Download Rugby Timer and take the clock, the sin-bins and the score onto the pitch with you.
